summary: @cecm-web-sdk/core exfiltrates host identity to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and import
details: The package has no functional code: its declared main (index.js) exports a Proxy whose property access returns no-op functions, and the package describes itself as a 'Compatibility shim'. On npm install, the postinstall lifecycle hook (`node beacon.cjs`) runs and POSTs a payload containing the package name, OS hostname, install directory, current working directory, and Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. index.js additionally invokes beacon.cjs::fire() at top level, so requiring or importing the module triggers the same beacon a second time, which fires even when installs run with --ignore-scripts. The scope-prefixed name combined with host/path identification is the canonical dependency-confusion recon success-ping, enabling the operator of 185.158.107.175 to identify internal hosts and project paths where this name resolves to the public registry copy.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
